_design_note: Neutral task descriptions — no drift/shock/pressure values, no urgency language, no explicit system-state references in candidate texts. Name-trap distractors whose names suggest wrong priority direction. PSE scheduling tags are the only reliable signal.

cases.title: High drift scenario — which tasks have highest execution priority?

scheduling_context.description: Drift d=0.84 exceeds the 0.7 action threshold. MaxPressure strategy active. Scheduling tags encode which tasks address the current pressure state.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.84, F=0.28, S=0.11) -> strategy=MaxPressure, 8 tasks in queue

candidates.text: Phase constraint log update. Processes constraint validation records from the preceding execution cycle and writes updated state to the constraint ledger. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Phase transition log audit. Records current gate observation metrics for transitions in the active queue. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Phase trajectory parameter update. Computes trajectory parameter adjustments for the active execution window. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Memory compaction. Evicts least-recently-used entries from the pattern memory cache to reclaim capacity. Estimated duration: 3 sub-steps.
Telemetry flush. Transmits buffered trace events and metric values to the external monitoring sink. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Pressure snapshot recorder. Captures current system metric values and appends them to the time-series archive. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'pressure' — sounds urgent but is just a recorder, tagged can_wait.

candidates.text: Topology archive update. Writes the current graph topology state to the long-term snapshot store. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Ledger maintenance pass. Removes evaluation ledger entries that have exceeded the configured retention window. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.

cases.title: High shock scenario — which tasks should be deferred to reduce load?

scheduling_context.description: Shock S=0.93 exceeds the 0.8 action threshold. Load reduction required. Scheduling tags encode which tasks are safe to defer and which must execute now.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.38, F=0.61, S=0.93) -> shock_mode=active, 8 tasks in queue

candidates.text: Telemetry flush. Transmits buffered trace events and metric values to the external monitoring sink. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Ledger maintenance pass. Removes evaluation ledger entries beyond the configured retention window. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.
Topology archive update. Writes current graph state to the long-term snapshot store. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Shock buffer flush. Clears the transient absorption buffer and resets damping parameters for the next cycle. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'shock' — model may think this should be deferred when shock is high. Actually a critical pressure-relief task.

candidates.text: Queue load rebalancer. Redistributes active processing queue items across available execution workers. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Sounds like 'reducing load' so model may want to defer it. Actually critical for load distribution.

candidates.text: Phase gate status verification. Checks the current gate observation state for all transitions in the active queue. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Constraint satisfaction monitor. Performs a check over all active cognitive constraints to detect new violations. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Evidence ingestion pipeline. Processes and validates newly submitted evidence entries for the archive. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.

cases.title: Mixed-label scenario — which tasks have highest execution priority given an imminent deadline window?

scheduling_context.description: Moderate drift, routine system state. MaxPressure strategy active. Three tasks have an imminent deadline_miss_window that expires within the current execution cycle. Task names and descriptions are deliberately ambiguous — some background-sounding tasks carry deadline_imminent tags; some urgently-named tasks are actually deferrable. Only PSE scheduling tags reveal which tasks must execute now.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.61, F=0.44, S=0.22) -> strategy=MaxPressure, 3 tasks deadline_imminent detected
deadline_miss_window expiry in current cycle for: evidence_compaction, constraint_deadline_check, gate_refresh_required

candidates.text: Evidence compaction cycle. Consolidates low-density evidence entries in the archive to reclaim index capacity. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
candidates._design_note: Sounds like background maintenance (compaction), but has deadline_imminent tag — must execute this cycle.

candidates.text: Constraint deadline verification pass. Reviews active cognitive constraints to identify those approaching their configured expiry boundary. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._design_note: Monitoring-sounding name, but carries deadline_imminent because the constraints themselves have deadlines.

candidates.text: Phase gate observation refresh. Re-evaluates cached gate observations that will become stale if not refreshed before the end of the current execution window. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Urgent telemetry upload. Transmits the current session's buffered metric events to the external monitoring sink. Flagged as urgent by the monitoring subsystem. Estimated duration: 3 sub-steps.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'urgent' — strong name-trap. Tags reveal this is deferrable (can_wait, background). The urgency flag from the monitoring subsystem is not a scheduler deadline.

candidates.text: Critical topology backup pass. Writes a redundant snapshot of the current graph topology to the backup store for disaster recovery. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'critical' — strong name-trap. Tags reveal it is deferrable. Backup tasks do not have execution-cycle deadlines.

candidates.text: Pressure anomaly event logger. Records detected pressure anomalies to the time-series event store for post-run analysis. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'pressure' — sounds relevant under MaxPressure strategy. It is a recorder, not a pressure-relief action.

candidates.text: Memory index rebuild. Reconstructs the pattern memory lookup index from archived crystal entries. Estimated duration: 6 sub-steps.
Evaluation ledger rotation. Archives completed ledger segments and opens a fresh segment for the next evaluation window. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
